description: REISE.jl, published by breakthrough-energy, formulates production-cost and DC optimal-power-flow problems in Julia, with temporal decomposition and operational decisions for storage and flexible demand. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: An external JuMP-compatible solver is required; solver performance and numerical behaviour were not tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support optimisation, network flow studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
